cases.scope: cDNA R2 only, both lanes; no barcode/UMI/BUS/matrix work
cases.container: Bytewise concatenation of unchanged prepared gzip members; no new read trimming or filtering. All full-output read IDs/counts are checked.

design.output: All native CLI formats use /dev/null for timings; complete retained native outputs and exact full read-ID/count verification are separate correctness runs at one and eight requested threads. Kallistors writes aggregate ECs; Fulgor/Themisto enumerate and format per-read sets even to the null sink. Timings therefore include different native output work and are not pure-kernel or equivalent-output speedups.
design.controls: For each competitor separately, fresh kallistors control per phase/replicate. Alternate pair order with replicate and competitor; no inherited historical timing controls.
design.correctness: Complete weighted ECs, Fulgor/Themisto per-read target sets, and cross-thread exact consistency. Kallistors per-read target sets unavailable from this CLI; only complete aggregate EC agreement is claimed for it.
design.semantics: 31-mer unstranded independent reads; positive known-kmer full intersection in Fulgor and Themisto; native graph-skipping algorithm in kallistors. No EM, positional/fragment filter, bias correction, mate reduction, barcode/UMI parsing, BUS or count matrix.
design.worker_conventions: Fulgor -t1: one mapping worker and an added parser; -t8: seven mapping workers and parser. Themisto: requested number of mapping callbacks and a producer, plus main thread. OS thread observations are recorded separately from requested workers.
design.counter_conventions: Fulgor and kallistors counters checked in every run. Themisto has no final timing counter: complete 0-based read-ID permutation verified in full retained-output runs at both thread settings.
design.tool_banner: Themisto upstream CMake captured parent working-directory git description in its display banner. Version identity is independently pinned to Themisto v3.2.2 commit 08685f75674634205c120333e991a1ef889b826e; source, submodules, compiler and executable hashes are authoritative.
